requirements.title: The compositor shall retain explicit plate calibration.
requirements.description: The photographic shot shall pin plate bytes and provenance, display mapping, mask, source fit, output crop and calibration evidence separately from authentic app media.

validation.notes: NOT EXECUTED. Follow the named DS-PHOTO-CALIBRATION protocol, including its counterexample, and retain actual inputs, commands, receipts, results and reviewer verdict. The protocol is a verification plan, not passing evidence.

requirements.title: The compiler shall refuse unsupported photographic motion.
requirements.description: When photographic strategy is selected, the compiler shall allow changing screen content and declared crop moves while refusing true parallax, rotation, articulation or physical relighting outside its qualified envelope.

requirements.title: The compositor shall replay pinned photographic shots.
requirements.description: The compositor shall evaluate each output sample from pinned plate, mapping, mask, presentation and source clocks and produce a saved receipt without regenerating the plate.

requirements.description: When AI photographic scene generation is requested, the adapter shall use a configured supported owner route, retain prompt/requested-versus-honored controls, provider/model and actual-or-unknown cost, and require final-look/calibration review before use while preserving imported-plate workflows.
